technical.summary: Mixed technicals with strong volume confirmation and trend support offset by price below key moving averages and overbought stochastic conditions; moderate risk/reward for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: AMD shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 89 days—insufficient smart money alignment for actionable signal.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (16/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 purchase, 1 exchange, 1 sale) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (432.0), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising USD pressuring multinational earnings, FOMC event just passed, and earnings in 89 days create compounded uncertainty.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme fear sentiment (16/100) with 15x volume spike, bullish OBV, and supertrend support create contrarian entry opportunity near 94.18 support level.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising USD), price below all key moving averages (EMA21/50, SMA50), overbought stochastic, high earnings risk in 89 days, and zero smart money/insider conviction eliminate margin of safety.

decision.entry_rationale: While extreme fear sentiment (16/100) and 15x volume spike present contrarian opportunity, severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising USD) combined with price below all key moving averages eliminate margin of safety for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: VIX at crisis levels (432.0) with FOMC just passed and earnings in 89 days create compounded tail risk; price rejection below support could accelerate downside in unfavourable macro environment.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already 39 positions in Information Technology sector; adding AMD would increase concentration risk in high-volatility sector during macro stress.
